The official Firecrawl pricing page lists the Hobby plan at 5,000 credits per month. The price is $19/month, or $16/month billed annually. Hobby includes 5 concurrent requests, basic support, and an auto-recharge pack of 1,500 credits for $9. A Proxidize review dated October 5, 2026 matches this, saying Hobby is $19 month-to-month or $190 per year for 5,000 credits per month.

Several third-party sources report older figures: 3,000 credits for $16/month. Those include a Toolradar listing of 3,000 credits per month and a ScrapeGraphAI post dated March 2026. A webscraping.ai FAQ gives 20,000 credits for $20/month, which doesn't match any other source, so I'd treat it as unreliable.

The Firecrawl billing docs also mention a Hobby 6.5k tier at $28/month or $290/year and a Hobby 8k tier. This suggests the Hobby allowance may be adjustable, so the live pricing page is the best place to confirm current numbers.

Firecrawl's Hobby plan includes **5,000 credits per month**, according to the official pricing page. It costs $19/month, or $16/month billed annually.

- **Older figure:** Some third-party pages list 3,000 credits for $16/month. That looks like an earlier version of the plan.
- **Possible tiers:** The billing docs mention larger Hobby tiers (6.5k credits for $28/month, and an 8k tier). The Hobby allowance may therefore be adjustable, so check the live pricing page for current numbers.
- **Unreliable source:** One FAQ site says 20,000 credits for $20/month. It matches no other source, so I'd ignore it.
